info.name: SevaNest Backend API
info.description:
All 267 operations of the SevaNest API (OpenAPI generated). Folders follow the module lifecycle (create, list, read, update, state change, delete). Ids are captured into collection variables by the tests of create/list requests. Each request checks: no 5xx, a documented status or a business-state answer (404/409/422), response time under slowMs, the standard error envelope.

Order: run "00 Start here" first, then the module folders from top to bottom. Some operations only succeed once earlier state exists (for example a booking must be ACTIVE before attendance); a 409/422 there is an accepted answer.
